title: Official Record Authority and Blockchain Crosswalk — 2026
question: What does official record mean across federal records management, CFTC recordkeeping, securities ownership, corporate accounting, audit and public disclosure, and what changes when blockchain or DLT is permitted to hold the record?
bluf: Official record is not one universal legal status. Authority, the exact recorded object, the accountable keeper and the consequence determine officialness for each purpose. The September 24 CFTC staff FAQ permits covered entities to keep qualifying regulatory records natively on-chain without a separate off-chain duplicate solely because blockchain is used, but the responsible entity must still satisfy content, retention, production, outage and inspection duties. That permission does not make blockchain consensus the controlling ownership record, a GAAP conclusion, sufficient audit evidence or settlement finality.
